newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING -- ExpressPoint Technology Services Inc.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING -- ExpressPoint Technology Services Inc.

text.p: Company Name ExpressPoint Technology Services Inc
Total shares to be offered 2.0 million

Underwriters over-allotment 300,000 shrs Business: Burnsville, Minn-based company has agreed to acquire Amcom and Delta Parts, two technology support service companies in order to create a platform from which to launch the development of an international company.

Use of Proceeds: For the payment of the cash portion of the purchase price for the acquisition, associated expenses, repayment of certain notes issued to Amcom employees in September and general corporate purposes.
